answer: Watch for dormant accounts waking up together. One account coming back after 10+ idle epochs is normal. But if more than 3x the 30-epoch average wake in the same epoch, each account in that wave gets at most one seat per panel for its next 5 epochs. They still grade and earn, just never stacked. Say a farm parked 60 accounts, yarrow-01 to yarrow-60, to age them, then woke them all to pass each other's copper mine pitches about Oasis Ridge. They'd land one per panel and get outvoted by honest seats. To dodge it the farm has to trickle them back over weeks.
